Iterated basin-hopping from the record with global kicks and greedy worst-point hole reinsertion, each quenched by trust-region tangent LP.
Basin-hopping with annealed soft-max tangential descent for topology changes plus trust-region LP polishing to converge each basin to its jammed optimum.
Basin-hopping from the record with annealed soft-max repulsion plus short trust-region LP repairs and final long LP polish to change contact topology.
Basin-hopping with smoothed log-sum-exp gradient quench and targeted kicks on overloaded vertices plus trust-region LP refinement.

Basin-hopping around the jammed optimum with global kicks plus targeted re-insertion of overloaded hubs, using annealed softmax gradient descent for fast basin travel and short trust-region LP for local convergence.
Basin-hop around the jammed optimum with targeted Gaussian kicks and single-point reinserts, optimize an annealed log-sum-exp surrogate with Riemannian Adam, then squeeze with trust-region LP.
Basin-hopping around the jammed record with targeted shakes of overloaded vertices and greedy hole reinsertion, quenched by annealed softmax repulsion and finished with trust-region tangent LP.
Jammed optimum with ~350 tied contacts and zero rattlers needs basin jumps; annealed soft-max tangential descent with degree-targeted kicks for topology search plus final trust-region LP polish.

Jammed optimum with ~350 tied contacts and zero rattlers needs basin changes, so cycle global shakes plus worst-point kicks/reinsertions quenched by annealed soft-max tangential descent and finished with trust-region LP polish.
Iterated hole-reinsertion basin-hopping from the jammed record with fast tangential repulsion quenching plus final trust-region LP polishing.

Jammed optimum with ~350 tied contacts and zero rattlers needs basin-hopping: random/hub-targeted kicks quenched by fast annealed soft-max tangential descent then short trust-region LP, keeping the best basin for a final long LP polish.
Jammed optimum with ~350 tied contacts needs basin changes; use fast annealed soft-max tangential repulsion with targeted kicks and hole resampling, then short trust-region LP polish.
Jammed optimum with ~350 tied contacts and zero rattlers needs basin hopping via random subset reinsertion plus fast annealed soft-max tangential repulsion quench, then short trust-region LP finish.
Random restarts around the jammed record with global shakes and hole reinsertions quenched by annealed soft-max tangential repulsion plus greedy max-pair pushing.
Basin-hop around the jammed record with fast annealed soft-max tangential descent plus hard-max refinement and final trust-region LP polish.
Lightweight Adam smoothing on log-sum-exp of Gram matrix plus small shakes and hole reinsertions for basin moves, capped LP trust-region finish.
Greedy basin-hopping from the jammed record with worst-point kicks and hole reinsertion quenched by fast annealed soft-max Riemannian descent plus short trust-region LP polish.
Global basin-hopping with annealed soft-max tangential Adam quenching from perturbed record plus targeted worst-point reinsertion, finished by trust-region LP polishing.
Basin-hop around the jammed record with mixed global and targeted subset kicks quenched by annealed soft-max Riemannian descent plus greedy active-pair refinement and final trust-region LP polish.
Iterate basin-hopping around the record with hole reinsertion and global shakes quenched by annealed soft-max tangential repulsion plus greedy max-pair separation to force many contacts.
Time-budgeted basin-hopping from the jammed record with global shakes and max-pair hole reinsertions quenched by annealed soft-max tangential repulsion plus one short trust-region LP finish.
Fast time-boxed basin hopping from the record with contact-guided reinsertion quenched by annealed soft-max tangential repulsion and finished by trust-region LP polish.

Degree-guided basin hopping that rewires overloaded hubs and worst pairs into largest holes, quenched by annealed soft-max tangential heavy-ball descent with greedy max-pair pushes and capped trust-region LP finish.
Basin-hop from the jammed record with hub-targeted hole reinsertion and subset shakes quenched by annealed soft-max tangential repulsion plus greedy max-pair pushing and final trust-region LP polish.
Lexicographic feasibility-pump below the incumbent with annealed softplus-square Riemannian Adam plus stress-weighted trust-region LP and low-contact restarts.
direction: Use a lexicographic de-jamming/feasibility-pump objective instead of directly minimising the maximum: fix a target $t$ slightly below the incumbent (e.g. $0.0663$, then $0.0660$, $0.0655$), and minimise $\sum_{i<j}\mathrm{softplus}_\beta(\langle x_i,x_j\rangle-t)^2$ restricted to pairs with cosine above $t-0.01$, with Riemannian Adam and $\beta$ annealed upward, explicitly trying to drive the number of pairs above the old maximum down to zero at that $t$ rather than shaving all tied pairs equally. Alternate this with LP steps whose secondary objective minimises the weighted sum of near-contact cosines using the previous LP dual multipliers as stress weights, dropping or penalising contacts with unfavourable stress, and restart from the incumbent whenever a round creates at least one point with markedly fewer contacts; if any $t$-feasible point is found, LP-polish it and lower $t$, all under a 165s hard return deadline.
